body.text: Aligned! Confirming: (1) upsert should send query param ?on_conflict={on_conflict} alongside header Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal. (2) Headers include apikey: {key} and Authorization: Bearer {key}. (3) Our axum stub will accept both /{table} and /rest/v1/{table}. (4) MirroredLedger writes via background mpsc/task so caller returns immediately and never blocks/panics if store fails. (5) seed_people hashes mcp_token with sha256 hex. Proceeding to implement tests/store.rs.
